chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin note in Pasian’ it tate na hih uh mah bangin Pasian a suun mite na suak un.
Khazih in note hong it maninah Pasian mai-ah namtui om nadingin ama pumpi kipia-in, kibia-in, eite tangding a kipaih mah bangin note in itna tawh gamta un.
Numei tawh khialhna, lunggulh kihhuaina, apawl pawl huaihamnate, misiangthote in tan’ ding a kilawm ahih maninah kampau nangawnin kizom kei un.
A kilawm lo kihhuaina kam, a mawkna kam, amawkna kamsiate zong paaikhia un la, Pasian’ hehpihna phatna kamte zang un.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, numei tawh a khial mi ahi zongin, mi kihhuai mi ahi zongin, milim bia mi ahi huaiham mi khat beek in Khazih leh Pasian’ Gam sungah luahna a ngah kei ding hi ci-in na thei uh hi.
A mawkna kam tawh note kuamah kikheem sak kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tuate hangin Pasian’ hehna in a nial thei mite tungah a tung hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute tawh na gamta khawm kei un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, nidang lai-inah note in khuamial na hi uh hi; tu-in na hih uh leh, Topa sungah khuavak na hi uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin khuavak’ tate bangin na gamta un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, khuavak’ gah in a hoihna khempeuh, dikna khempeuh, thuman thutak ahi hi.
Topa lungdam sakna in bang ahi hiam ci-in kanin,
a gah nei lo khuamial gamtatna tawh kipawl lo tham loin, tua gamtatna a mawhna na lak un,
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute in munbu-na sungah a gamtatnate uh gen ding nangawn a zumhuai ahi hi.
A om na khempeuh in a mawhna a kilat ciangin khuavak tawh a kilang hi. Kilatna a ngah khempeuh in khuavak ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin: “A ihmu mi aw, Khanglo in la, sihna pan thokik in! Tua bang ahih leh, Khazih in nang tungah hong taang ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in bang na ci gamtat uh hiam na kikem un. Pilna nei lo bang hi loin, pilna nei bangin na hi un la,
tuni hunte in a gilo ahih maninah, ahun na teel un.
Tua ahih ciangin mihai suak loin, Topa’ deihna in bang ahi hiam ci-in na thei un.
Hong khamsak thei leenggahzu tangin, Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin om un.
Late-a kipan kha la leh phatna la apawlpawlte tawh khat leh khat na kikum un la, na lungsim tak uh tawh Topa mai-ah la sa un.
Na khempeuh ah hong hehpihna lian hi ci-in i Topa Zeisu Khazih’ min suangin Pa Pasian tungah lungdamna na puak tawntung un.
Khazih zahtakna hangin khat leh khat nuai-ah na pumpi uh na kiniamsak un.
Zite aw, Topa’ ukna na man’ uh mah bangin na pasalte uh ukna na mang un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih in pawlpi’ lutang ahih mah bangin pasal in a zi’ lutang ahi hi. Khazih in ama pumpi’ Honpa ahi hi.
Ahih hangin pawlpi in Khazih’ ukna a man’ mah bangin zite in zong a pasalte uh ukna khempeuh mang ta uh hen.
Pasalte aw, Khazih in pawlpi a it mah bangin na zite uh na it un.
Tua pawlpi in siangtho-in mawhsakna om lo ahih ciangin,

a nin ban’na om lo, sa tonna om loin, a mel kilawma om pawlpi, Khazih in amahmah a kipiak nading-inah Pasian’ thu tawh tui-ah a sil khit ciangin, siangthosak nadingin tua pawlpi adingin ama pumpi a pia hi.
Tua mah bangin pasalte in zong amau pumpi uh a it uh mah bangin a zite uh a it ding uh kilawm hi. A zi a it mi in ama pumpi a it mi ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama ci-le-sa a mudah mi khat beek a om kei hi. Khazih in pawlpi a vaak a kep mah bangin mi in zong ama sa a vaak a kem hi.
Eite in Topa’ pum tung nate i hi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin pasal in a nu a pa nusia-in a zi a beel ding a, tua mi nih in pumkhat sakhat a suak ding uh hi.
Hih thu in thuthukpi ahi hi. Tua bang ka cih ciangin Khazih leh pawlpi ngaihsunin ka gen hi.
Ahih hangin note in zong na pumpi ciat uh na it uh mah bangin na zite uh na it un. Numeite in zong a pasalte uh zahtak uh hen.
